title: GroundedResponse
description: Required output structure for every answer generated by the grounded generation pipeline. Core fields are mandatory. The model must return exactly this shape.

recommendation.description: A short, direct answer to the clinical question in plain language. Must contain no claim that isn't supported by the evidence/citations below.

evidence.description: The exact retrieved excerpt(s) that support the recommendation, quoted or lightly trimmed — not paraphrased away from the source wording. Empty only when confidence is 'insufficient' (a refusal).

citations.description: One entry per source excerpt used. Every non-refusal recommendation must be traceable to at least one citation. Empty only when confidence is 'insufficient' (a refusal).

document.description: Exact document name as it appears in your ingestion metadata (document_name field).

section.description: Section title or number, e.g. 'Chapter 1 Drug-susceptible TB treatment'.

exact_quote.description: Exact quoted sentence or snippet for text search highlighting in PDF viewer.

bbox.description: Bounding box coordinates [x0, y0, x1, y1] on the page for rectangle highlighting.

file_name.description: The exact PDF file name in data/ directory (e.g. 'Module 3 Diagnosis.pdf').

confidence.description: high: strong direct match in retrieved text. medium: partial/indirect match. low: weak or conflicting match. insufficient: below retrieval confidence threshold — recommendation must then be a refusal message, not a guess.

retrieved_chunks_count.description: Diagnostic metadata: total candidates retrieved by hybrid search.

evidence_count.description: Diagnostic metadata: number of final evidence chunks passed to generator.

selected_evidence_preview.description: Diagnostic metadata: preview of the final selected evidence chunks.

examples.recommendation: WHO recommends the use of a molecular WHO-recommended rapid diagnostic (mWRD) as the initial diagnostic test for pulmonary TB in adults.
examples.evidence: WHO recommends the use of a molecular WHO-recommended rapid diagnostic test (mWRD) rather than sputum smear microscopy as the initial diagnostic test for all adults with signs and symptoms of pulmonary TB.

citations.exact_quote: WHO recommends the use of a molecular WHO-recommended rapid diagnostic test (mWRD) rather than sputum smear microscopy as the initial diagnostic test

examples.recommendation: I don't have sufficient evidence in the indexed WHO Tuberculosis guidelines to answer this question.
